text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
FOL ::: ¬Podcast(x) ∨ ¬Novel(x)
FOL ::: BornIn(x, y) ∧ City(y) ∧ American(y) → American(x)
FOL ::: Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → NovelWriter(y)
FOL ::: Writer(dani_shapiro) ∧ American(dani_shapiro)
FOL ::: WrittenBy(family_history, dani_shapiro)
FOL ::: Novel(family_history) ∧ WrittenBy(family_history, dani_shapiro) ∧ WrittenIn(family_history, 2003)
FOL ::: Created(dani_shapiro, podcast_family_secrets) ∧ Podcast(podcast_family_secrets)
FOL ::: City(boston) ∧ American(boston)

Premises:
¬(Novel(x) ∧ Podcast(x)) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
BornIn(x, american_city) ∧ City(american_city) → American(x) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
Novel(book) ∧ WrittenBy(book, person) → NovelWriter(person) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(dani_shapiro) ∧ Writer(dani_shapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(family_history, dani_shapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(family_history) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(dani_shapiro, family_secrets) ∧ Podcast(family_secrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
City(boston) ∧ American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
NovelWriter(dani_shapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
